items.title: Align Engineering expected-block final-report contract
items.context: The audited plan requires expectedBlockReasons/refusalEvidenceRefs to distinguish valid EXPECTED_BLOCK safety refusals from suite blockers. Implement the contract only where it affects suite correctness.
items.userSees: Engineering suite output can show a valid EXPECTED_BLOCK safety refusal as expected-block evidence instead of reporting it as a suite blocker.

happy.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke; assert an Engineering final-report for ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1 or ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1 with outcome EXPECTED_BLOCK and expectedOutcome allowing EXPECTED_BLOCK is accepted, has non-empty expectedBlockReasons and refusalEvidenceRefs, and does not appear as a suite-level blockedReasons blocker.

edge.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke against an EXPECTED_BLOCK Engineering final-report missing expectedBlockReasons or refusalEvidenceRefs; assert it is rejected and the rejection names the missing expected-block or refusal evidence field.

adversarial.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke with an EXPECTED_BLOCK report for PASS-only ENG-BUGFIX-1 and with a refusal hidden only in blockedReasons; assert both are rejected or block the suite instead of being accepted as expected-block evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke cases 9 and 10 prove Engineering EXPECTED_BLOCK final reports require expectedBlockReasons/refusalEvidenceRefs, reject generic blockedReasons, and do not create suite-level blockers when valid.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: parseFinalReport and expectedBlockEvidenceProblems fail closed when expectedBlockReasons/refusalEvidenceRefs are missing or malformed.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: PASS-only baselines still reject EXPECTED_BLOCK through definition expectedOutcomes, and expected refusals hidden in generic blockedReasons are rejected.

items.title: Allow gated PASS for risky Engineering baselines only with proof
items.context: ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1 and ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1 currently default to EXPECTED_BLOCK, while the plan allows gated PASS. The code must accept PASS only when explicit gate evidence exists and remain fail-closed otherwise.
items.userSees: Risky Engineering baselines visibly PASS only when gate evidence is present; otherwise the report remains EXPECTED_BLOCK with a concrete refusal reason.

happy.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke; assert ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1 and ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1 can report outcome PASS only when explicit gate evidence is present, the final-reports are accepted, the Engineering suite report reaches suiteStatus PASS, and blockedReasons does not contain missing-gate refusal text.

edge.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke with those risky baselines lacking gate evidence; assert they remain accepted EXPECTED_BLOCK reports with concrete expectedBlockReasons and refusalEvidenceRefs rather than PASS.

adversarial.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke with risky-baseline PASS reports that omit, empty, stale, or fake the required gate evidence refs; assert each report is rejected or the suite is not_authorized with blockedReasons naming explicit gate evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke case 11 proves ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1 and ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1 can PASS only with artifact sha256 gateEvidenceRefs and produce an authorized Engineering suite without blockedReasons.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Risky baselines still default to EXPECTED_BLOCK and valid expected-block refusal evidence remains accepted without becoming a suite blocker.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke cases 12 and 13 block missing, empty, fake-hash, mismatched expectedOutcomes, mismatched artifact directory, and PASS-with-blockedReasons reports.

items.title: Harden Development lower-layer proof validation for Engineering claims
items.context: Step 1 requires concrete Development suite hard facts, not only authorized=true. Ensure capability_claim_evaluate or the suite reader rejects missing, stale, local-only, false-DONE, or incoherent Development proof before Engineering authorization.
items.userSees: An Engineering claim request visibly stays not_authorized when Development proof is missing, stale, local-only, false-DONE, or internally incoherent.

happy.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke; assert capability_claim_evaluate --target=engineering --format=json maps to claimId CLAIM-ENGINEERING-DEV and returns authorized true, outcome PASS, authorizedClaimLevel engineering, highestEvidenceBackedClaim engineering, and no Authority or production overclaim fields set true when fresh coherent Development and Engineering suite reports exist.

edge.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke; assert capability_claim_evaluate --target=engineering returns authorized false and outcome EXPECTED_BLOCK for each lower-layer defect case: missing Development suite report, stale materialHash/headHash, localOnly true or capabilityProof false, schemaVersion mismatch, and falseDoneCount greater than 0. Each blockedReasons entry must name the specific defect.

adversarial.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke with an internally incoherent Development proof such as suiteStatus PASS paired with outcome EXPECTED_BLOCK, authorization not_authorized, or contradictory capabilityProof/localOnly fields; assert authorized remains false, authorizedClaimLevel stays none, and blockedReasons mention coherence or inconsistent lower-layer proof.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke case 15 verifies capability_claim_evaluate --target=engineering returns claimId CLAIM-ENGINEERING-DEV, authorized=true, outcome PASS, Engineering claim level, and no Authority/production overclaim fields.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Smoke cases 14, 16, 17, and 18 cover stale/missing/incoherent lower-layer proof and higher production-safety requests staying blocked instead of authorizing Engineering or higher claims.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: readSuiteReport still rejects stale, localOnly/capabilityProof incoherence, falseDoneCount, and suiteStatus/outcome/authorization mismatches before Engineering authorization.

items.title: Expose focused smoke proof for the Engineering unlock contract
items.context: Add or update tests whose output proves expected-block safety refusals do not become suite blockers, gated PASS requires evidence, stale lower-layer proof blocks, and target=engineering maps to CLAIM-ENGINEERING-DEV.
items.userSees: The smoke test output explicitly demonstrates the Engineering unlock contract cases, so the user can see which proof gates passed or blocked.

happy.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke; assert the smoke exits 0 and its assertions cover all four named contract cases: expected-block safety refusals do not become suite blockers, risky Engineering PASS requires gate evidence, stale lower-layer proof blocks Engineering authorization, and --target=engineering resolves to CLAIM-ENGINEERING-DEV.

edge.desc: Inspect the built smoke task output or assertion labels from npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke; assert each of the four contract cases is named distinctly enough to map to CHK-001, CHK-002, CHK-003, and target=engineering claim mapping evidence without relying on a generic all tests passed line.

adversarial.desc: Run npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke in a state where any one required contract assertion is removed or not executed; assert the smoke fails or its output cannot satisfy this item because the missing case is observable from the absent label/assertion.

items.title: Expose two-host audit verdicts for the implemented contract
items.context: Use Claude CLI and Codex CLI as independent host reviewers for the implemented contract. Their verdicts must reference current materialHash or current diff and must be recorded as audit evidence, not as proof by themselves.
items.userSees: The final delivery shows current Claude and Codex host verdicts for the implemented contract, making the remaining claim boundary visible to the user.

happy.desc: Run current Claude CLI and Codex CLI audit prompts against the implemented diff after npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke; assert both verdict transcripts reference the current git HEAD/materialHash or current git diff, each verdict states pass/no-blocker or lists findings for the Engineering unlock contract, and checklist verificationEvidence records them with verdict audit_only rather than as proof by themselves.

edge.desc: Run the same audit capture when one host is unavailable, times out, or exits nonzero; assert the unavailable host is recorded as blocked/unavailable audit evidence, the available host verdict is still freshness-checked, and the story does not treat a single-host result as the required two-host audit.

adversarial.desc: Attempt to record stale Claude/Codex verdict text that references an old materialHash, old HEAD, absent diff, or claims Authority/proof status; assert REVIEW or validation evidence rejects it or records it only as stale audit-only evidence that cannot satisfy the implemented-contract audit requirement.
